from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p=Path(d)/'r.json'
    stale=p.with_name(p.name+'.progress.tmp')
    stale.write_text('STALE')
    c.persist(p,{'status':'OBSERVED_PENDING_REVIEWED_CONTRACT','rows':99,'failures':0})
    body=json.loads(p.read_text())
    assert body['rows']==99
    assert stale.read_text()=='STALE', "stale file must be untouched (not a suffix collision)"
    assert list(Path(d).glob('*.tmp'))==[stale], "only the original stale survives"
print("ok stale-not-blocking")

print("== adversarial: two concurrent persist calls do not collide ==")
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p=Path(d)/'r.json'
    p.write_text('{}')
    c.persist(p,{'i':1})
    with patch.object(Path,'replace',side_effect=OSError('first replace races')):
        try: c.persist(p,{'i':2})
        except OSError: pass
    c.persist(p,{'i':3})
    assert json.loads(p.read_text())['i']==3
    leftovers=sorted(Path(d).glob('*.tmp'))
    assert all(not str(x).endswith('.progress.tmp') for x in leftovers), leftovers
    print("unique sibling temps:", [x.name for x in leftovers])
print("ok unique-sibling-no-collision")

print("== adversarial: parse_checksums tolerates a hash with extra leading space ==")
try:
    c.parse_checksums(' '+'a'*64+'  /audit/file\n')

except ValueError as e:
    print("ok rejects leading whitespace:", e)

print("== adversarial: parse_checksums tolerates multi-hash stream w/ repeat ==")
stream = ('a'*64+'  /audit/x\n' + 'b'*64+'  /audit/y\n' + 'a'*64+'  /audit/x\n')
try:
    c.parse_checksums(stream); print("FAIL should raise dup")
except ValueError as e:
    print("ok dup:", e)

print("== adversarial: parse_checksums path containing '#' or '=' is preserved ==")
out = c.parse_checksums('c'*64+'  /audit/file#frag\n'+'d'*64+'  /audit/sub/dir=v\n')
print("ok paths:", out)

print("== adversarial: parse_checksums CR/LF line endings ==")
for ending in ['\n','\r\n','\r']:
    try:
        c.parse_checksums('e'*64+'  /audit/file'+ending+('f'*64+'  /audit/g'+ending))
        print("ending", repr(ending), "FAIL")
    except Exception as e:
        print("ending", repr(ending), "raises:", e)

print("== adversarial: parse_checksums whitespace-only line stream (no hashes) ==")
try:
    c.parse_checksums('\n\n\n')
except ValueError as e:
    print("ok blank-stream:", e)

import importlib.util, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('collect',Path('tools/php83/template-generation/collect.py'))
c=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(c)

print("== CRLF & CR semantics are intentionally strict ==")
out = c.parse_checksums('e'*64+'  /audit/file\n'+'f'*64+'  /audit/g\n')
print("LF stream parses:", len(out)==2)
# The collect parser only sees sha256sum output, which is LF; strict LF is correct.

print("== adversarial: persist when target's parent is missing ==")
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p=Path(d)/'missingdir/report.json'
    try:
        c.persist(p,{'x':1})
        print("created with missing parent: success")
    except Exception as e:
        print("missing parent raises:", type(e).__name__, str(e)[:80])

print("== adversarial: persist hit by KeyboardInterrupt in middle of write ==")
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p=Path(d)/'r.json'; p.write_text('orig')
    class Kill(Exception): pass
    real_flush = None
    import os
    with patch('os.fsync', side_effect=Kill):
        try: c.persist(p,{'x':1})
        except Kill: pass
    body = p.read_text()
    print("orig preserved:", body=='orig')
    print("leftover .tmp:", list(p.parent.glob('*.tmp')))

print("== adversarial: parse_checksums rejects paths leaking \\\\ (windows style) ==")
try: c.parse_checksums('a'*64+'  C:\\\\audit\\\\file\n')
except ValueError as e: print("ok rejected:", e)

print("== adversarial: parse_checksums path with NUL char (no whitespace) ==")
try: c.parse_checksums('a'*64+'  /audit/file\x00bad\n')
except ValueError as e: print("ok rejected:", e)
